column1: # class-overrides.tsv — per-class runner accommodations for
# run-hibernate-reactive-suite.sh
# Same schema/semantics as apps/hib-suite-runner/class-overrides.tsv — see that
# file's header for the full rationale on why this table exists and is force-
# added to git despite apps/ being gitignored wholesale.
# FORMAT — tab-separated, three columns. `#` comments and blank lines ignored.
#   <fully.qualified.TestClass>   <timeout-seconds | ->   <extra VM flags | ->
#   timeout   a FLOOR, not an absolute: the class runs with
#             max(this, the run's --timeout/$TIMEOUT). `-` = no override.
#   flags     extra CratonVM flags appended for this class only, before the
#             @common.args argfile. Space-separated. Already-present flags are
#             not duplicated. `-` = none.
# Verify the table is actually live before trusting a suite run:
#     ./run-hibernate-reactive-suite.sh overrides
# EMPTY as of the initial harness validation (2026-08-03): no full `categorize`
# run has happened yet (needs a live reactive DB — see README.md / DB-
# REQUIRED.md). Populate this once a categorize run against a real DB surfaces
# classes that need more than the flat --timeout, the same way hib-suite-runner
# accumulated its table from real runs.
# 2026-08-17 — the two accommodatable classes from the residual seven. See
# known-issues/hibernate-reactive/residual-seven-after-the-afc-fix-20260817.md.
# Both produce CORRECT results and simply need longer than the suite's flat
# 120s: 219s and 286s measured, against HotSpot's 18.5s and 13.5s. The cause is
# one measured defect (functional-interface dispatch at 8-10x HotSpot's
# INTERPRETER) and it is filed; reporting it as a FAIL every run costs the next
# reader the same investigation without adding information.
# The flags column is what does the work here, not the timeout column: the
# deadline that fires first is JUnit's, set for the whole suite by common.args.
# 540s keeps a margin under each fixture's OWN 10-minute Vert.x @Timeout, which
# no flag can reach.
# The other three (MultithreadedInsertionWithLazyConnectionTest,
# it.LocalContextTest, techempower.TechEmpowerTest) are deliberately NOT here:
# they exceed that hardcoded Vert.x budget, so no override can rescue them and
# they stay reported as FAIL.
org.hibernate.reactive.MultithreadedInsertionTest
org.hibernate.reactive.MultithreadedIdentityGenerationTest
